data.name: VSM_001
data.value: This mist is getting thicker...[pause=10] I can barely see anything.

data.name: VSM_002
data.value: Hey, [player]...[pause=10] Does it feel like we're being watched?

data.name: VSM_003
data.value: ...Yeah.[pause=15] For a while now.

data.name: VSM_004
data.value: What the...[pause=0]?!

data.name: VSM_005
data.value: A Pokémon just burst out of the ground!

data.name: VSM_006
data.value: And that one...[pause=15] it was waiting for us.

data.name: VSM_007
data.value: The herd protects its territory...

data.name: VSM_008
data.value: Who...[pause=10] who said that?!

data.name: VSM_009
data.value: It doesn't matter.[pause=20] These creatures will not let you pass without a fight.

data.name: VSM_010
data.value: Show them your resolve...[pause=20] or perish.

data.name: VSM_011
data.value: No choice![pause=10] [player], let's fight!

data.name: VSM_012
data.value: They're still here...[pause=15] We're not losing this time!

data.name: VSM_013
data.value: We did it![pause=10] Those two were tough...

data.name: VSM_014
data.value: But that voice...[pause=15] Who was that?

data.name: VSM_015
data.value: I don't know.[pause=20] Let's keep moving.

data.name: VSM_016
data.value: They disappeared...[pause=15] Come on, let's continue the mission.

data.name: VSM_017
data.value: Not strong enough yet...

data.name: VSM_018
data.value: But you will rise again.[pause=30] They always do.

data.name: VSM_019
data.value: N-non...[pause=10] Ils sont trop forts...[pause=15] On doit battre en retraite...

data.name: VSM_020
data.value: Mudbray pousse un hennissement triomphal.[pause=15] Stantler baisse la tête,[pause=10] les bois toujours chargés.

data.name: VSM_021
data.value: Tu as bien combattu, petit.[pause=30] Mais la harde ne tombe pas si facilement.

data.name: VSM_022
data.value: La brume les enveloppe à nouveau...[pause=20] Ils retournent dans la steppe.

data.name: VSM_023
data.value: Mudbray s'effondre, groggy.[pause=10] Stantler recule,[pause=5] ses bois perdent leur éclat.

data.name: VSM_024
data.value: Stantler te fixe longuement.[pause=20] Puis il s'incline — un signe de respect.

data.name: VSM_025
data.value: Tu as gagné le droit de passer, étranger.[pause=25] La harde se souviendra de toi.

data.name: VSM_026
data.value: Ils repartent dans la brume... [pause=15]Cette fois sans hostilité.

data.name: VSM_027
data.value: On a gagné ![pause=10] Je n'arrive pas à y croire...

data.name: VSM_028
data.value: La harde protège les siens.[pause=20] Tu aurais fait pareil à leur place.
